_comment: marble_trapdoor: the walkway trapdoor's moving parts, for the hole marble_build cuts on a pier in TRAPDOOR_BEARINGS: four lane cells from the section wall's strip to the wall, over its 6 m pit. Origin the deck point at r 53.989 (mid-hole) on the hole's centre bearing, y 0 the deck, +X radial out, +Z toward increasing bearing. TrapdoorFrame: near-black iron rim inside the hole, 0.35 deep, its lane sides straight chords (0.28 m at the narrowest), five knuckles along each hinge. TrapdoorLeaf00 (inner, hinged on the lip chord) and TrapdoorLeaf01 (outer, on the wall chord): two 0.15 m stone flaps 5.55 m wide meeting at a seam along the lane, darker worn flags, five iron strap hinges and an iron lip on the free edge, iron undersides; node origin is the hinge axis at the flap's bottom arris, local +X along the hinge, local +Z toward the free edge: +90 deg about local X hangs it (to 5.7 m). TrapdoorSpikes: pale stone spikes on a 0.9 m grid over the pit floor (y -6.0), tips -5.15..-4.9, 0.45 m clear of the rim. NO colliders: the scene gives the flaps their bodies.
